title: Apple - AirPods Pro 2, Wireless Active Noise Cancelling Earbuds with Hearing Aid Feature - White

description: PIONEERING HEARING—AirPods Pro 2 unlock the world’s first all-in-one hearing health experience: a scientifically validated Hearing Test,⁴ clinical-grade Hearing Aid feature, and active Hearing Protection.⁵

INTELLIGENT NOISE CONTROL—Active Noise Cancellation removes up to 2x more background noise.¹ Transparency mode lets you hear the world around you, and Adaptive Audio seamlessly blends Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency mode for the best listening experience in any environment.² And when you’re speaking with someone nearby, Conversation Awareness automatically lowers the volume of what’s playing.⁶

IMPROVED SOUND AND CALL QUALITY—The Apple-designed H2 chip helps to create deeply immersive sound. The low-distortion, custom-built driver delivers crisp, clear high notes and full, rich bass in stunning definition. Voice Isolation improves the quality of phone calls in loud conditions.⁶

CUSTOMIZABLE FIT—Includes four pairs of silicone tips (XS, S, M, L) to fit a wide range of ear shapes and provide all-day comfort. The tips create an acoustic seal to help keep out noise and secure AirPods Pro 2 in place.
DUST, SWEAT, AND WATER RESISTANT—Both AirPods Pro 2 and the MagSafe Charging Case are IP54 dust, sweat, and water resistant, so you can listen comfortably in more conditions.⁷

PERSONALIZED SPATIAL AUDIO—With sound that suits your unique ear shape along with dynamic head tracking, AirPods Pro 2 deliver an immersive listening experience that places sound all around you.³ You can also listen to select songs, shows, and movies in Dolby Atmos.

A HIGHER LEVEL OF CONTROL—Simply swipe, press, and hold the stem to manage playback functions using Touch control. And with Siri Interactions, simply nod your head yes or shake your head no when Siri asks if you’d like to hear a message, answer a call, or manage a notification.⁶
LONG BATTERY LIFE—Get up to 6 hours of listening time with Active Noise Cancellation enabled. And get up to 30 hours of total listening time with Active Noise Cancellation enabled, using the case.⁹

A MORE CAPABLE CASE—Keep track of AirPods Pro 2 with Precision Finding and a built-in speaker.¹⁰ A lanyard loop helps keep your AirPods Pro 2 close. Charge with an Apple Watch or MagSafe charger, USB-C Charge Cable, or Qi-certified charger.¹¹

product_description: AirPods Pro 2 - featuring pro-level Active Noise Cancellation, Adaptive Audio, Transparency mode, Personalized Spatial Audio, and a breakthrough in hearing health with a scientifically validated Hearing Test, clinical-grade Hearing Aid capability, and active Hearing Protection.

q_a.question: What is the battery life of these earbuds?
q_a.answer: These earbuds have a battery life of 6 hours.

q_a.question: Do these earbuds have a warranty?
q_a.answer: Yes, these earbuds have a 1-year limited warranty for both parts and labor.

q_a.question: What is the maximum talk time on these earbuds?
q_a.answer: The maximum talk time is 24 hours.

q_a.question: Are these earbuds noise cancelling?
q_a.answer: Yes, these earbuds feature active noise cancellation.

q_a.question: How long does it take to charge these earbuds?
q_a.answer: A 5-minute charge provides 1 hour of playtime.

q_a.question: What kind of charging interface do these earbuds use?
q_a.answer: These earbuds use a USB-C charging interface.

q_a.question: Is this in any way better than the airpod pros 2 that is already out? Or is the only change the charging port becoming USB-C. In other words is this worth waiting for over the airpod pros with the lightning port
q_a.answer:
It's an "updated" case with new model numbers for each part as well as USB-C instead of lightning, and technically it's better in that it support lossless audio when paired with Apple's Vision Pro headset (coming early 2024), whereas the lightning ones don't. 
But functionally, they should be more or less identical to the lightning ones except for the details I've listed above.

reviews.title: Love my AirPods! Clear Sound
reviews.content:
Got the AirPods Pro 2 and they’ve been in constant use ever since. Noise canceling is excellent on flights, in the office, and walking around town. Take them out of the case and they just work, no fussing with apps or pairing every time.
The sound is clear, calls come through clean, and the hearing aid feature is a nice extra if you need a little boost in conversation. Battery lasts through a full day with the case, and the fit stays comfortable for hours.
Simple, reliable, and worth it. These are the ones we actually remember to grab every morning.
I’ve had the 2’s before and I continue to buy them.

reviews.title: Worth the Price
reviews.content: I wear these daily and I love the sound quality and transparency mode so I can still hear things around me while walking. The noise cancelling is fantastic too.  The battery life lasts longer than most other headphones I’ve used. The case can get dirty and scratched easily, but I clean it every so often so I don’t run into charging issues. One tip for people: if you notice your transparency and noise cancelling modes don’t seem to be working as intended you might need to clean the microphones on the back of the AirPods by using a piece of duct tape to pull out all the dirt and dust that builds up over time. I was shocked at the difference before and after I cleaned mine for the first time so now I do it when I clean the case too.
